newsitem.title: USA: Morrison Knudsen issues MK Rail shares.
newsitem.headline: Morrison Knudsen issues MK Rail shares.

text.p: MK Rail Corp said Thursday Morrison Knudsen Corp has completed the distribution of its 11.1 million shares of MK Rail stock.

The shares, which represent 63 percent of MK Rail's 17.6 million shares outstanding, were distributed primarily to Morrison Knudsen's creditors as part of Morrison Knudsen's plan of reorganization from bankruptcy.
The deal officially ends MK Rail's association with Morrison Knudsen, MK Rail said.
Morrison Knudsen merged with Washington Construction Group as part of the reorganization.
